title: Non-European Mathematics Manuscripts: Multilingual Translation Drafts and Modern LaTeX Sources
version: 2026-06-03 reconstructed work-level readers and al-Battani v083 text
description:
Working corpus of modern LaTeX readers and translations for selected non-European mathematics manuscripts and historical mathematical texts. This satellite record is intentionally reader-facing: readable top-level PDFs come first, followed by compact TeX/source artifacts and current work packets. Large raw source drops, page-image working archives, superseded drafts, and broad provenance bundles are preserved on the main project landing and bulk-preservation record instead of being re-uploaded here on every update.

Status at a glance. [#########-] front-facing reader set: currently 68 PDFs and about 7996 reader pages; [##########] al-Battani text stream: segments 1-100 promoted as a trilingual Arabic/English/Chinese reference reader; [#---------] al-Battani numeric table stream: table-reference material is included but the numerical astronomical tables remain an in-progress reconstruction; [#######---] multilingual quality-control stream: the reconstructed work-level readers and combined readers have been refreshed from the latest accepted deltas, while source-completeness checks remain active for selected Arabic, Sanskrit, and Chinese items.

Current update. This version promotes a reconstructed 66-reader non-Battani work-level release with corrected combined readers, plus an al-Battani v083 trilingual text/reference reader and table-reference supplement. The attached compact ZIP artifacts preserve the release manifest, checksums, TeX/source material, and current al-Battani v083 package. The al-Battani numerical tables are not claimed complete in this version.

Source and provenance layout. Project-generated TeX and compact current work artifacts are attached here. Full raw/provenance preservation is maintained on the main project record, concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20393488, so this record can be updated without repeatedly moving multi-gigabyte working archives.

Workflow provenance: public-domain or openly available source witnesses are transcribed into TeX, translated where useful, checked locally, and published with artifacts so readers can inspect and improve the work. The default licensing target for project-generated transcription and translation layers is CC0 where legally available.
notes: Latest update promotes reconstructed work-level readers and al-Battani v083 trilingual text/reference material. The al-Battani numerical tables remain in progress.
